alt.en: Night on a rocky coast. Under a dark, clouded sky, moonlight breaks on a curling wave and spreads in bright broken patches over wet rocks and foam in the foreground.
alt.zh: 夜里的岩岸。昏暗多云的天空下，月光碎在一道卷起的浪上，又在前景湿漉漉的礁石和浪沫间散成明亮的碎片。

note.en: Homer spent his later years at Prouts Neck on the coast of Maine and painted the Atlantic in every weather. The title names a lighthouse, but the painting gives almost everything to the moon on breaking water, laid down in thick, quick strokes. It is the loudest sea on this wall, and still a calm picture.
note.zh: 霍默晚年住在缅因州海岸的普劳茨角，画过各种天气下的大西洋。题目点了一座灯塔的名，画面却几乎全部交给了碎浪上的月光，笔触厚而迅疾。这是这面墙上最喧响的一片海，却依然是一幅平静的画。
